# GamingOnLinux — platform limitations of a 2013 bundle

- Original source: [GamingOnLinux — platform limitations of a 2013 bundle](https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2013/08/the-cheapskates-corner-15-aug-23rd29th/)
- Author / publication: muntdefems / GamingOnLinux
- Language / date: English; 2013-08-23
- Access: Relevant article passage inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

This bundle roundup excludes Robin Hood from its Linux offerings despite the existence of a native port. The author explains that Meridian 4's distribution rights covered the Windows version.

The preceding [August 16–22 column](https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2013/08/the-cheapskates-corner-14-aug-16th22nd/) describes the practical distinction: the bundle supplied a Steam key for Windows, while the native edition was on Desura.

These are contemporary reports about that offer. The underlying distribution agreement was not inspected, and the account does not establish current rights or store availability. It is useful evidence for why buying one edition did not necessarily provide another platform's build.
